summary.one_liner: WrenAI is an open-source generative BI (GenBI) engine that gives AI agents a governed semantic layer (MDL) and AI context layer so they can generate governed SQL and deploy dashboards across 22+ data sources.
summary.what_it_does: The repo provides a CLI (installed via pip as wrenai) and skills that let agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex answer business questions with SQL planned against a Modeling Definition Language (MDL) semantic layer, with dry-plan validation and row limits. Business definitions, enums, joins, and examples are stored as version-controlled YAML and Markdown files (instructions.md, queries.yml). It can build browser-side GenBI dashboards powered by wren-core-wasm and deploy them to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages. A local LanceDB memory index supports hybrid retrieval. The core engine is written in Rust on Apache DataFusion, with Python and npm bindings and LangChain and Pydantic AI integrations. The README also describes a Git Sync feature for pushing the repo to Wren Cloud or a self-hosted install, which is commercial.
use_cases: let AI agents write governed SQL against a business database
maintain metric definitions and business context as files in Git
generate and deploy a shareable BI dashboard from an agent
connect an LLM agent to Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake, or DuckDB
add a semantic layer on top of an existing warehouse
expose a semantic layer to MCP clients and LangChain agents
how_to_run: pip install "wrenai[postgres,memory]" (add connector extras as needed)
In your agent, in a project folder, ask: "Use Wren to set up my Postgres database."
notable: Semantic layer defined in MDL and stored as reviewable YAML/Markdown in a Git repo the user owns
Agent skills installed via npx skills add, with workflow guides fetched from the CLI on demand
Browser-side GenBI dashboards deployable to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages
22+ data source connectors on one Apache DataFusion engine
Legacy Docker-based Wren AI app preserved on the legacy/v1 branch
caveats: Dashboards, row- and column-level security, Agentic Mode, and Git Sync are commercial (Wren AI Cloud or Enterprise Plus), not part of the Apache-2.0 core
The earlier chat-first Docker app (Wren GenBI Classic) is archived on legacy/v1 with no new features or security fixes
keywords: let my agent query my database
share a dashboard with my team
